description: Will there be a geomagnetic storm in the next few days? Returns the NOAA SWPC predicted Kp for each 3-hour block over the next 3 days, the daily maximum, the peak block and any G-scale storm expected. For planning aurora trips and checking storm watches. Forecasts are uncertain by hours and 1-2 Kp; observed values are in kp_index_now. (cost: 1 credit)
name: kp_forecast_3day
